'''Kisoyt Soliger''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]]. Stationed inside at the end of the hallway before the first Elevator of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], he is confronted by a rebel trooper and killed in the firefight.
